doc: Recorded by `atd record --capability reader.databricksBundle` from what the desktop host's module shows when parity/cases/databricks/pipeline/job-commands.json of etalii.adp.ide.desktop opens its document; never edited by hand.

input.body:
# Two jobs and two pipelines in one file, each reading with a finding of its own.
bundle:
  name: twin_bundle

resources:
  jobs:
    job_a:
      name: Job A
      tasks:
        - task_key: ingest
          job_cluster_key: missing_cluster
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/a_ingest
        - task_key: shape
          depends_on:
            - task_key: ingest
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/a_shape
    job_b:
      name: Job B
      tasks:
        - task_key: ingest
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/b_ingest
        - task_key: report
          depends_on:
            - task_key: absent
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/b_report
  pipelines:
    pipe_a:
      name: Pipe A
      catalog: main
      schema: bronze
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/a
    pipe_b:
      name: Pipe B
      schema: silver
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/b

targets:
  dev:
    mode: development
  prod:
    mode: production

findings.message: 'ingest' runs on cluster 'missing_cluster', which this job does not declare. Declare it under job_clusters, or clear the binding for serverless.
'report' depends on 'absent', which is not a task in this job. Fix the key or remove the dependency.
No target says default: true, so every deploy must name one. Mark one target as the default.
The pipeline 'Pipe B' sets a schema but no catalog, so the schema has nowhere to live. Set catalog too.
